findings.title: Load fallback catalogs for non-controller translations too
findings.body: Loading the fallback catalogs here only covers controller requests. The translation accelerator still loads only I18n.config.locale, and I18n::Backend::Fallbacks looks up each fallback directly on the backend without invoking the lazy loader. A background mail job using a user's partially translated locale can therefore skip translations present in the site's default locale if that catalog has not already been loaded. Load the fallback chain at the translation entry point rather than relying solely on ApplicationController#set_locale.

findings.title: Account for the site fallback locale in the translation cache
findings.body: Fallback results now depend on SiteSetting.default_locale, but translate_accelerator caches no-argument translations using only the key, current locale, and backend object ID. For a user whose locale remains unchanged, a missing key resolved through the old site default can remain cached after the default locale changes, causing subsequent requests to serve the old language without evaluating this fallback list. Include the effective fallback chain in the cache key or invalidate these entries when the site default changes.
